Test Description: Configure GPIO inputs to trigger on falling edges and verify that interrupts are raised and cleared correctly for randomly chosen pads.
Remarks: Uses system interrupt enable for the selected GPIO source. Relies on an interrupt handler to clear a software flag. A specific SRAM address is used to stimulate edges. Pads are selected randomly without repetition.
Test Steps / Procedure:
1) Enable INTR_EN1 for the relevant GPIO interrupt source.
2) For a randomly selected pad, configure GPIO_8 (offset by pad index) for input with negative-edge interrupt enabled.
3) Enable the pad bit in gp0_intr2_intr_en1.
4) Stimulate a falling edge using the SRAM location to toggle the pad input.
5) In the interrupt handler, read GPIO_8 (offset) and verify input and raw status bits.
6) Read INTR1_INTR_STS1 and verify the group status bit for the pad.
7) Clear the interrupt in the per-pad register and verify the readback value.
8) Verify that INTR1_INTR_STS1 is cleared.
9) Clear RAW_STCR1 for the GPIO interrupt and verify it is cleared.
Validation / Acceptance Criteria:
1) Input status after the falling edge indicates the expected level → PASS.
2) Raw interrupt status bit for the pad is set upon the event → PASS.
3) Group interrupt status bit for the pad is set → PASS.
4) After clearing, the per-pad register readback matches the cleared value → PASS.
5) After clearing, the group interrupt status reads zero → PASS.
6) System raw interrupt status is cleared after the clear operation → PASS.

Feature: Negative edge interrupt enable - walking zeros pattern
Test Description: Validate negative-edge interrupt behavior on GPIO inputs using a walking-zero stimulus across pads 8 to 39. Confirm raw, group, and system interrupt statuses set and clear correctly via the interrupt handler.
Remarks: GPIO0 or GPIO1 is selected at compile time. Uses an interrupt handler. Stimulus is generated through a memory-mapped location. All pads from 8 to 39 are exercised sequentially.
Test Steps / Procedure:
1) Enable the GPIO interrupt source in INTR_EN1 and enable the processor interrupt.
2) Program GPIO_8 and subsequent per-pad registers to enable negative-edge detection for pads 8 through 39.
3) Configure pads 8 through 39 for input using GPIO_IO_CTRL_GROUP1, GPIO_IO_CTRL_GROUP2, GPIO_IO_CTRL_GROUP3, and GPIO_IO_CTRL_GROUP4.
4) Enable per-pad group interrupts in INTR1_INTR_EN1 for pads 8 through 39.
5) For each pad from 8 to 39, apply an input transition to create a falling edge and wait for the interrupt to occur.
6) In the interrupt handler, read the per-pad register (GPIO_8 plus offset) to check input state and raw status.
7) Read INTR1_INTR_STS1 to verify the group interrupt status for the active pad.
8) Clear the per-pad interrupt by writing the clear sequence to the corresponding per-pad register (GPIO_8 plus offset) and verify the readback indicates cleared.
9) Verify that INTR1_INTR_STS1 indicates no pending group interrupts for the pad after clear.
10) Clear the system raw interrupt in gpio_intr_raw_stclr1 and confirm the status bit is cleared.
Impacted Registers: INTR_EN1, GPIO_8, GPIO_IO_CTRL_GROUP1, GPIO_IO_CTRL_GROUP2, GPIO_IO_CTRL_GROUP3, GPIO_IO_CTRL_GROUP4, INTR1_INTR_EN1, INTR1_INTR_STS1, gpio_intr_raw_stclr1
Validation / Acceptance Criteria:
1) Per-pad input status read after the falling edge → Input bit indicates the expected active state.
2) Per-pad raw interrupt status after the event → Raw status bit is set.
3) Group interrupt status for the active pad → Corresponding bit in INTR1_INTR_STS1 is set.
4) After the per-pad clear sequence → Per-pad readback indicates the interrupt is cleared.
5) After clearing the per-pad interrupt → INTR1_INTR_STS1 reads zero for the group status.
6) After clearing the system raw interrupt → The corresponding system raw status bit reads as cleared.

Test Description: Configure GPIO pads for output and verify that setting and clearing outputs are reflected on the observed pad state.
Remarks: Pads 8 to 39 are targeted. A fixed memory location is used for observation. Compile-time selection controls the GPIO instance.
Test Steps / Procedure:
1) Program gpio_io_ctrl_group1 with 0x00FF00FF to enable output mode.
2) Program gpio_io_ctrl_group2 with 0x00FF00FF to enable output mode.
3) Program gpio_io_ctrl_group3 with 0x00FF00FF to enable output mode.
4) Program gpio_io_ctrl_group4 with 0x00FF00FF to enable output mode.
5) Enable per-pad interrupts in gp0_intr1_intr_en1 by writing 0xFFFFFFFF.
6) For each pad from 8 to 39, write gp0_gpio_8 plus offset with 0x00200000 to drive output high, then write 0x00000000 to drive output low.

Validation / Acceptance Criteria:
1) After driving an output high → The observed pad state indicates high for the corresponding pad bit.
2) After driving an output low → The observed pad state indicates low for the corresponding pad bit.
3) Any mismatch in observed state versus driven value → Counted as an error.
